note: Every piece of text the level creator shows (task T-233). The creator is the board's own tool, never shipped to players, so the labels are plain. Buttons fit about 16 characters, panel category names about 12. Each entry has a text and a where note. Change a text here, no code change.

list_title.where: Title at the top of the list screen.

new_level_button.where: List screen: button that creates a level; the only thing on the list when there are no levels.

play_action.where: List screen: button on each listed level, starts it as a full run.

edit_action.where: List screen: button on each listed level, opens it in the editor.

default_level_name.where: Editor: the name a new level starts with.

name_field_label.where: Editor: label of the level name field.

category_ground.where: Editor side panel: category of ground tiles.

category_roads.where: Editor side panel: category of road pieces.

category_buildings.where: Editor side panel: category of buildings.

category_boulders.where: Editor side panel: category of boulders.

category_rooftops.where: Editor side panel: category of rooftops.

category_ramps.where: Editor side panel: category of ramps.

rooftop_height_3.where: Editor side panel, Rooftops: label of the height 3 rooftop.

rooftop_height_6.where: Editor side panel, Rooftops: label of the height 6 rooftop.

ramp_height_0_3.where: Editor side panel, Ramps: label of the ramp from the street (0) up to height 3.

ramp_height_3_6.where: Editor side panel, Ramps: label of the ramp from height 3 up to height 6.

rotate_label.where: Editor: button that switches the piece to its next view.

mirror_label.where: Editor: button that flips the piece.

style_label.where: Editor top bar: button that steps the style (textures) of the next rooftop or ramp placed; {style} is the style's name.

style_office.where: Editor top bar, Style button: the office rooftop and office wall textures.

style_carpark.where: Editor top bar, Style button: the car park deck and garage wall textures.

style_t198.where: Editor top bar, Style button: the first placeholder textures (T-198's).

delete_label.where: Editor: button that removes the selected piece.

save_label.where: Editor: button that saves the level.

save_confirmation.where: Editor: message shown after a successful save.

overlap_message.text: Can't place here: it overlaps another piece.
overlap_message.where: Editor: message shown when a piece can't be placed because it overlaps another piece.

back_button.where: Editor: button that returns to the list screen.

controls_hint.text: Mouse: place. R: rotate. M: mirror. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge listing the controls.

size_hint.where: Editor top bar: hint while the board drags out a rooftop's size (T-251).

size_readout.where: Editor top bar: width and depth readout while sizing a rooftop; {w} and {d} are filled in by the creator (T-251).

ramp_dir_north.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing north (T-251).

ramp_dir_east.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing east (T-251).

ramp_dir_south.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing south (T-251).

ramp_dir_west.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing west (T-251).

ramp_height_0_6.where: Editor top bar or side panel, Ramps: height label of a ramp from the street (0) up to height 6, if T-251 adds one.

road_corner.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the corner road tile (T-252).

road_t_junction.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the T-junction road tile (T-252).

road_crossroads.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the crossroads road tile (T-252).

road_dead_end.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the dead end road tile (T-252).

category_props.where: Editor side panel: category of props (T-253).

prop_barrier.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the concrete barrier (T-253).

prop_cones.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the traffic cones (T-253).

prop_crates.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the crate stack (T-253).

prop_ac_unit.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the air conditioning unit (T-253).

prop_water_tank.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the rooftop water tank (T-253).

prop_roof_vent.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the roof vent (T-253).

prop_street_lamp.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the street lamp (T-253).

prop_roof_sign.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the rooftop sign (T-253).

building_small.where: Editor side panel, Buildings: label of the small square building (T-254).

building_long.where: Editor side panel, Buildings: label of the long building (T-254).

controls_hint_sizing.text: Mouse: place. Drag: size a rooftop. R: rotate. M: mirror. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint_sizing.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge, the controls with dragging to size a rooftop added (T-250). Replaces controls_hint, which is kept unchanged.
